written.title: GTA 6 Nearly Hit With Ban Over ‘Frequent Male Genital Exposure’
written.description: What GamesRadar+, Kotaku, Polygon and Push Square reported about Jason Duval on 12 November 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Jason Duval, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 12 November 2026

[GTA 6 was almost refused classification in South Korea due to the sheer amount of genitals shown](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-was-almost-refused-classification-in-south-korea-due-to-the-sheer-amount-of-genitals-shown/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Also, the naked Jason seen in leaks seemingly isn't part of the final game

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Notably, it's mentioned that the leaked footage featuring Jason naked is not included in the final game.

## Kotaku, 12 November 2026

[GTA 6 Was Almost Refused Classification In South Korea For Featuring Too Many ‘Out-Of-Context’ Penises](https://kotaku.com/gta-6-south-korea-for-featuring-too-many-out-of-context-penises-rockstar-2000756253)

The outlet's own summary:

> Unfortunately, South Korea's GCRB may have just indirectly confirmed that GTA 6's protagonists cannot get naked in the retail version of the game

> It appears the previous rulings had been based on leaked footage showing Jason running around in the buff .

> More specifically, Cyberleek shared videos of Jason hanging dong and Lucia skydiving in the nude .

> It sounds like the GCRB was concerned that Jason and Lucia could strip down to their birthday suits in normal gameplay, and the committee members only chose to approve the Adults Only rating once they were able to confirm otherwise.

> This seems to indirectly imply that Jason cannot, in fact, hang dong in GTA 6 .

## Polygon, 12 November 2026

[GTA 6 Nearly Hit With Ban Over ‘Frequent Male Genital Exposure’](https://www.polygon.com/gta-6-south-korea-rating-male-nudity/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Hog wild

> It's possible that this assessment was shaped by the massive GTA 6 gameplay leaks that took place over the summer, which showed Jason interacting with unclothed patrons at a nudist resort and nonchalantly cruising around the streets of Miami with his dong hanging out .

> Related GTA 6 fandom is shook after the nude Jason leak Massive Grand Theft Auto 6 leak sparks conspiracy theories about Cyberleek's build and whether it reflects the final playable game Posts Google is changing how it surfaces content.

## Push Square, 12 November 2026

['Genital Exposure Has Never Appeared This Frequently': GTA 6 Was Almost Refused Release in South Korea](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/genital-exposure-has-never-appeared-this-frequently-gta-6-was-almost-refused-release-in-south-korea)

The outlet's own summary:

> Balls to this

> Genitals To Avoid 6 19 Balaam_ 2 hours ago I’m of the Seinfeldian mindset. “I have a strict limit on the number of naked men I need to see in one day: zero.” 6 20 GenX79 2 hours ago Cyberpunk was the first game I played that featured similar content.

> 3 17 Brundleflies21 2 hours ago It's good that Rockstar want to show male genitalia..warts and all.

> Not Jason's member getting me to buy a 900eur console...

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
